#!/bin/sh
set -e

DATE=$(date +%Y-%m-%d)
ARCHIVE="inventory-${DATE}.tar.gz"
TMP="/tmp/${ARCHIVE}"

tar -czf "$TMP" -C "$(dirname "$SRC")" "$(basename "$SRC")"
scp -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no "$TMP" "${DEST_HOST}:${DEST_DIR}/${ARCHIVE}"
rm -f "$TMP"

ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no "$DEST_HOST" "find '${DEST_DIR}' -maxdepth 1 -name 'inventory-*.tar.gz' -mtime +6 -delete"
ANTRIEB_EOF

sudo mv /tmp/inventory-backup.sh /usr/local/sbin/inventory-backup.sh
sudo chown root:root /usr/local/sbin/inventory-backup.sh
sudo chmod 755 /usr/local/sbin/inventory-backup.sh
ls -la /usr/local/sbin/inventory-backup.sh

(crontab -l 2>/dev/null; echo "0 2 * * * /usr/local/sbin/inventory-backup.sh >> /var/log/inventory-backup.log 2>&1") | crontab -
crontab -l
/usr/local/sbin/inventory-backup.sh; echo EXIT=$?
